name: AI Slop
summary: Mass-made generated images in social feeds: a plastic gloss, a generic subject, warped hands, false text and a bait caption. The word slop for such content spread in 2024.

philosophy.core_thesis: The image exists to fill a feed: it has a high finish, no author and no point, and its small errors show the lack of care.
design_principles: Pick a generic, emotive subject: a child with a cake, a log cabin at sunset, an animal made of fruit.
Render the subject at full gloss with a warm glow (#FFD08A) and a saturation of 120%.
Leave 1 to 3 faults in each image: an extra finger, a sign with false letters, or a seam in the background.
Put a bait caption of 16px to 20px above the image, in plain sans, with 2 to 4 emoji.
Add a reaction row with 3 round icons and a count in 14px under the image.
Set a square 1:1 or a 4:5 frame at 1080px wide, with a 1px light border on a light grey feed (#F2F3F5).
Post the same subject in 6 to 12 near copies, with small changes of colour or crop.
anti_patterns: A clear author credit and a stated purpose

layout.grid_mechanics: A single column feed of cards 480px to 680px wide; each card has a caption, an image and a reaction row, with 12px gaps.
layout.whitespace_ratio: 10% to 15% of the card stays empty; the spacing scale is 4, 8, 12 and 16px.
layout.alignment_rules: Flush-left caption and reaction row; the image fills the card width.
layout.container_geometry: Cards with an 8px radius; round reaction icons; the image has a 0px radius.

font_pairings.note: The plain feed sans that holds a bait caption.
A common system-like sans for a card feed.

hierarchy_rules: Set the caption in sentence case with emoji at the end.

color.palette_structure: A light grey feed with white cards, one blue for links and a hot orange-gold glow in the image.
color.contrast_rules: Ink text on white holds at least 16:1; blue links on white hold 5:1; the image glow is not used for text.
color.surface_treatment: Flat white cards; the image has a plastic gloss with an even, shadowless sheen.
color.light_and_shadow: A warm, even glow from all sides with no clear source; shadows are lifted and soft.

materiality.surface_simulation: A glossy, over-smooth render: plastic skin, waxy fruit and glassy wood.
materiality.border_rules: A 1px border in #DADDE1 on cards; the image has no border.
materiality.blur_and_elevation: A soft card shadow of 0 1px 3px at 15% black; a 6px to 12px bokeh behind the subject.

ornamentation_details.iconography: Outline icons at 20px with a 1.75px round stroke for like, comment and share.
ornamentation_details.illustration: A generic, over-rendered subject with a warm glow and one clear fault.

motion.transition_physics: The feed scrolls at normal speed; a like icon pops 1.2x for 200ms; images load with a 300ms fade.
motion.hover_and_active: Hover darkens the icon by 10%; active scales it to 1.2x for 200ms.

emotion.target_response: The viewer feels a faint hollow: it looks nice, and no one made it.

use_cases: examples in articles about feed quality
avoid_when: A brand needs to look careful and authored.
The page promotes real products that must be accurate.
The content serves vulnerable viewers who could take the bait.

modifiers.how: Remove the faults and the bait caption; set one clear subject with a deliberate light.
Replace the render with 6 plain phone photos and short, true captions.
Push the subject into a clear absurd image and add a deadpan caption.

pack.why: A common thin line set that matches a standard feed card and its reaction row.

ground.why: A soft light feed with one warm glow stands for the plain, even field around a glossy image.
